_partNote: Class images for the explorer tiles, rendered at about 74px. Following the rule in CLAUDE.md: one bold centered object per prompt, static or a single simple contact, no cutaways and no convergence. Quantum hardware is mostly boxes and vacuum chambers, so the seven silhouettes are pulled apart deliberately: a hanging tiered chandelier, a stack of stacked ring electrodes, a diamond plate on a mount, a chip with a fanned waveguide pattern, a tall cylindrical vacuum can with viewports, a small dish on a post, and a bare gold-free sample stage on a cold finger.
style: Minimalist technical illustration, the style of a precise patent drawing crossed with an isometric product sketch. Uniform-weight dark slate-gray ink linework with sparse, muted steel-blue accent shading (hex 4E7AA8) on a plain very light warm-gray background (hex F2F3F1). Three-quarter isometric view, single centered subject, generous margins. No text, no labels, no callouts, no logos, no humans, no background scenery, no drop shadows. Clean, engineered, calm. Strictly two colors plus the background: dark slate-gray line and muted steel-blue fill. Every material, including metal, glass and wiring, is drawn in that same palette. Absolutely no copper, brass, bronze, gold, orange, red, yellow or green anywhere, even where the real object would be that color. No glowing light, no beams, no sparkles. Favor open, airy linework with large unfilled light areas over heavy solid gray shading; the drawing should read as line art, not as a rendered solid model. Draw the subject as one whole object seen from outside. Do not draw a cutaway, a section view or an exploded assembly.

partPrompts.1: A cryostat assembly hanging free in the air, seen three-quarter: four round horizontal plates of decreasing diameter stacked one below the other on three slender vertical rods, widest at the top and smallest at the bottom, with a few thin cables running straight down between the plates. Open and skeletal, so the background shows through it. One assembly hanging alone, no outer vessel, no frame, no floor, no chip visible.
partPrompts.2: A small ion trap electrode assembly standing on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: four identical straight round rods arranged in a square, parallel to each other and held at both ends by two flat insulating end plates, with a short thin wire leaving one plate. Rigid and symmetric, and clearly four parallel rods. One assembly, no vacuum chamber, no lasers, no light, no atoms.
partPrompts.3: A single flat square diamond plate held in a simple mount, seen three-quarter: a thin clear rectangular slab with cleanly beveled edges, clamped at two opposite corners by a plain metal bracket on a low base. The slab is smooth and featureless. One plate in one mount, no light, no fluorescence, no microscope, no sample.
partPrompts.4: A photonic chip lying flat on a surface, seen three-quarter: a thin rectangular die whose top face carries a bold pattern of smooth curved lines that split repeatedly from a single line at one edge into eight lines at the opposite edge, like a branching tree, with a row of small square pads along one side. Flat and plate-like, with the branching pattern as the identifying feature. One die, no fibers, no packaging, no light.
partPrompts.5: A cylindrical ultra-high-vacuum chamber standing upright on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a squat round stainless body with a bolted circular flange around its rim and four short tube ports projecting radially from its sides at ninety degrees, each ending in a small bolted flange with a plain circular window. A single tube port stands up from the top. Exterior view only. One chamber, no pumps, no cables, no optical table, no lasers.
partPrompts.6: A small satellite ground-station telescope standing on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a short wide tube on a two-axis fork mount, tilted upward at about forty-five degrees, sitting on a simple tripod base. Plain and compact. One instrument, no dome, no sky, no beam, no stars.
partPrompts.7: A cold-finger sample stage standing alone on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a plain vertical cylindrical post rising from a round base plate, topped by a small flat square platform with four bolt holes at its corners, and one thin braided strap leaving the side of the post. Simple and bare. One object, no chamber, no wires beyond the single strap, no sample on the platform.
